The Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) Medical College and Hospital, Ranchi, has released a notification for the recruitment of 87 teaching positions on a contractual basis. Eligible candidates were invited to apply offline or via email by 02 November 2026. This overview details the historical notice parameters, requirements, and selection procedures for informational purposes.

Notification Overview

  • Issuing Authority: ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Ranchi
  • Notification ID / Reference: Not specified
  • Total Vacancies: 87 Posts
  • Posts: Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, and Senior Resident
  • Application Deadline: 02 November 2026 (Closed)
  • Mode of Application: Offline / Email

Vacancy Distribution

The 87 contractual positions span across 24 departments:

  • Professors: 11 Posts
  • Associate Professors: 19 Posts
  • Assistant Professors: 16 Posts
  • Senior Residents: 41 Posts (Anaesthesiology features the highest with 7 posts, followed by Medicine with 6)

Eligibility Criteria & Age Limits

  • Educational Qualifications: As per National Medical Commission (NMC) guidelines dated 30.06.2025 for respective disciplines.
  • Medical Registration: Candidates must hold an up-to-date medical registration with the NMC or State Medical Council.
  • Age Limits: Varies by department (e.g., up to 50 years for specific non-clinical departments like Anatomy and Pathology; 45 years for other departments; up to 69 years for retired doctors applying for Professor roles, counted as of the interview date).

Application Fee

  • General / Unreserved: Rs. 500/- via Demand Draft in favour of "ESIC Saving Fund A/c No.-2", payable at Namkum.
  • SC / ST / Female / PwD / Ex-Servicemen: Nil

Selection Stages

  1. Scrutiny of Applications: Verification of submitted documents against eligibility criteria.
  2. Interview: Tentatively planned for 05 or 06 November 2026 for shortlisted candidates.
  3. Final Result: Published on the official ESIC recruitment portal.

How to Verify

Applicants and interested researchers should cross-verify historical notices, updates, and future announcements directly on the official ESIC Recruitment Page to ensure accurate tracking of public sector opportunities.
